description: This file defines application configuration settings using environment variables. It includes a dataclass 'Settings' for storing configuration parameters such as database URL, JWT secrets, CORS origins, and turn time limit, along with a function to load these settings from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass that holds application configuration parameters loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: list[str] _split_csv(value: str)
methods.description: Utility function that splits a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Main function to load and return application settings from environment variables, with defaults and required validations.
